requirements.fretish: StickyActionEnv shall satisfy executed_action = previous_action | executed_action = intended_action.
StickyActionEnv whenever repeat_probability = 0 shall satisfy executed_action = intended_action.
StickyActionEnv whenever repeat_probability = 1 shall satisfy executed_action = previous_action.

variables.name: previous_action
variables.meaning: Previous action available for repetition at this observed step; history extraction is outside this projection.

variables.name: intended_action
variables.meaning: Intended new action supplied to step.

variables.name: executed_action
variables.meaning: Action executed at the observed step.

time_model.description: One logical observation per completed step call, pairing configured probability and intended/previous actions with the executed action; no physical timing or probabilistic trace measure is asserted.

explanation.text:
SCOPE: in the interval defined by the entire execution.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (executed_action = previous_action | executed_action = intended_action) must hold at some time point between (and including) the trigger and the end of the interval.
